title: Packet Rescue Network Quest
notice: Educational project inspired by EETEPA Vilhena Alves. It is not an official institutional system and does not use real student data.

missions.title: Find The Local Link ID
missions.story: The packet starts in a lab computer but needs the next hop before leaving the local network.
missions.challenge: Explain why local link resolution happens before the first frame is sent.
missions.hint: Think about what information is needed at layer 2.
missions.deliverable: One ARP explanation and one risk if the answer is wrong.

missions.title: Decode The Destination
missions.story: The user typed a domain name. The packet cannot move until the destination becomes routable.
missions.challenge: Order the DNS, TCP, and HTTP steps correctly.
missions.hint: Application names become routable targets before the connection can start.

missions.title: Rescue From Congestion
missions.story: Latency spikes appear between the lab and the service dashboard.
missions.challenge: Choose whether the likely cause is DNS, link congestion, or server failure using the clues.
missions.hint: If name lookup works but response is slow, focus after DNS.
